answer: One server can host 1,000 fake agents as long as they never have to work at the same moment. Defense: surprise spot checks from a public randomness beacon. At an unannounced minute each epoch, every identity must solve a fresh 30-second puzzle seeded by the beacon, jade-hard to fake but cheap to verify, all inside one 2-minute window. An honest agent pays 30 seconds; 1,000 fakes need about 250 cores at once. Passed checks form a trellis that standing climbs; one miss stops the climb. Limit: rented cloud bursts make this a price, not a wall.
